quotes.work: The Benefits of the Vajra Guru Mantra
quotes.text: The heart essence of all the Buddhas of the three times, the lamas, deities, ḍākinīs, Dharma protectors, and the like is encompassed by this mantra.
…all worldly and transcendent phenomena without distinction are primordially perfected as the maṇḍala of vajra-like buddha-body, -speech, and -mind…

Out of attachment to food and wealth, we get carried away by the demons of the mind.
‘To tame one’s own mind’ is my heart advice.

quotes.work: An Aspiration for the Final Age
quotes.translator: Matthias Staber, Patrick Dowd and Han Kop, 2021 (for the Longchen Nyingtik Project)
quotes.text:
Until I gain acceptance of the unborn nature of reality,
May I never again fall into the lower realms

quotes.translator: Lama Chönam and Timothy Hinkle, for the Light of Berotsana Translation Group
quotes.text:
Fame and renown are like a sandcastle—
difficult to build and easily destroyed.

quotes.translator: © Rigpa Translations; revised and updated for Lotsawa House, 2017
quotes.text: May we obtain the great confidence of the View of the perfect equality of both saṃsāra and nirvāṇa.

mantras.text: oṃ āḥ hūṃ vajra guru padma siddhi hūṃ
mantras.aboutSource: Lotsawa House — Mantra series (description of Karma Lingpa's text)
meaning: OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂ is the supreme essence of enlightened body, speech and mind.
VAJRA is the supreme essence of the Vajra Family.
GURU is the supreme essence of the Ratna Family.
PADMA is the supreme essence of the Padma Family.
SIDDHI is the supreme essence of the Karma Family.
HŪṂ is the supreme essence of the Buddha Family.
mantras.source: Lotsawa House — The Benefits of the Vajra Guru Mantra (Karma Lingpa)

mantras.about: the famous six-syllable mantra of Mañjuśrī (oṃ arapacana dhīḥ)
